It adds a speed of up to 800 kbit/s (constrained by SCL and SDA pull-up strength) beyond Standard mode (100 kbit/s) and Fast mode (400 kbit/s), and notes that the hardware provides a command abstraction layer to simplify the usage of the I2C peripheral.

The I2C (Inter-Integrated Circuit) bus allows ESP32-S3 to communicate with multiple external devices.
These external devices can share one bus.
